initial_plan.goal_evidence: Red sphere detected at axial depth 4.62m, surface range 5.48m. Appears elevated above terrain, likely on a distant ridge or plateau.
initial_plan.tentative_route: Move forward along the central valley path toward the red sphere. Maintain low posture to avoid terrain undulations. Prioritize forward motion over lateral deviation.
initial_plan.occlusion_hypothesis: Terrain features may occlude the sphere from view as approach. No immediate occluding structures visible in frame 0, but terrain rises ahead — potential for partial occlusion at closer range.
initial_plan.uncertainty: Terrain behind visible surfaces is unknown. Depth to sphere is estimated but not verified. Surface range suggests possible elevation or slope. No map or coordinates available.
initial_plan.revision_trigger: If forward motion reveals terrain blocking line of sight to sphere, or if sphere disappears from view without reaching it, revise route to flank or reorient.

result.arrival_endpoint: automatic 3 consecutive evaluator samples; separate from VLM STOP
